legislativeProvisions.heading: Application
legislativeProvisions.text: A school repair assistance programme is established. A public body operating a public education facility in this state may apply for assistance with repair of that facility; new construction is ineligible. Eligibility establishes no right to an award.

beneficiary.appliesToLabel: public bodies operating public education facilities

legislativeProvisions.heading: Which eligible repairs take priority
legislativeProvisions.text: When ranking eligible applications, the administering body shall give priority to repairs needed for safe entry, exit and physical accessibility, and shall publish its reasons for each ranking.

beneficiary.appliesToLabel: public bodies operating public education facilities

legislativeProvisions.heading: Limits and safeguards
legislativeProvisions.text: An application shall identify the proposed repair and the evidence supporting its priority. A priority finding under this Act is not a finding that a building complies with any other law. Assistance may not be used for operating salaries.

beneficiary.appliesToLabel: public bodies operating public education facilities

legislativeProvisions.heading: Commencement
legislativeProvisions.text: This Act takes effect upon enactment.

beneficiary.appliesToLabel: public bodies operating public education facilities

legislativeProvisions.heading: Total authorization
legislativeProvisions.text: There is authorized not more than $6,000,000 in total for the programme established by this Act. This is a single ceiling for the whole programme, not a recurring authorization. No money is appropriated by this Act. No award may be paid without a separate appropriation and designation under applicable law of a public body to administer the programme.
